# The Board Game Café

Official website: https://theboardgamecafe.co.uk/
Location: Unit 12, The Stables, Eanam, Blackburn BB1 5BY, United Kingdom
Phone: +44 7768 489048
Bookings: bookings@theboardgamecafe.co.uk
Events and private hire: events@theboardgamecafe.co.uk

The Board Game Café is an independent, family-friendly social venue in Blackburn. It offers board games, console gaming, desserts, karak chai, non-alcoholic drinks, birthday parties, group bookings, corporate events and private venue hire.

Live sport:
- The venue has a TNT Sports commercial subscription.
- Every UEFA Champions League game is available at the café, including Amazon Prime's exclusive Tuesday picks within the commercial package.
- Customers should contact the café to confirm the specific fixture and screen before travelling.

Current table pricing: £15 for the first hour per table including four drinks, then £8 per additional hour per table. The number of tables required depends on group size and is confirmed with the booking.
